name: repo.pre_pr
rests_on: Discover test and build commands from package.json scripts, pyproject.toml, Makefile, and AGENTS.md. call_job runs them in-process when run is true. No command is invented.

path.description: Project directory inside the workdir. Omit to use the workdir, or its single nested repo.

run.description: Execute the discovered test, build, lint, typecheck, and check commands. Omit or false to only list them.

only.description: Kinds to include: test, build, lint, typecheck, check. Omit to include every discovered kind.
